title: Level 3 Business Studies — Global Business Context 2024
subject: business-studies

questions.text:
Background: Kōwhai Naturals is a New Zealand based skincare company. Established in Christchurch in the early 2010s, Kōwhai Naturals exports to over 15 countries. Environmental sustainability is central to their business model, demonstrated through use of native plant extracts and fully recyclable packaging. They take social responsibility seriously, implementing ethical practices including fair wages, cruelty-free testing, and supporting local mānuka honey suppliers.

Kōwhai Naturals has grown to a size where they need to outsource some packaging to an overseas firm in Vietnam. They are considering Saigon Pack Co and Mekong Materials.

(a)(i) Explain one benefit to Kōwhai Naturals of using Saigon Pack Co to produce their packaging.

(a)(ii) Explain one benefit to Kōwhai Naturals of using Mekong Materials to produce their packaging.

(a)(iii) Which of the two packaging firms would you recommend for Kōwhai Naturals? Justify your recommendation, including any new information.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement: Explain one benefit of Saigon Pack Co (e.g. higher recycled content certification of 95% vs Mekong's 80%, helping meet sustainability goals) and one benefit of Mekong Materials (e.g. faster turnaround time of 14 days vs 21 days, important for maintaining stock levels in a growing business). Merit: Fully explain with further expansion about how these benefits impact Kōwhai Naturals' business goals. Excellence: For the recommendation, justify using relevant evidence. E.g. Kōwhai Naturals should use Saigon Pack Co because environmental sustainability is central to all decisions, making the higher recycled content the priority. Saigon Pack Co also has a lower minimum order of 1,000 vs 5,000 units, important for testing new product lines. Note: A recommendation for Mekong Materials is acceptable if suitably justified.

questions.text:
The quality of the packaging produced by the Vietnamese firm has not met Kōwhai Naturals' expectations. Kōwhai Naturals is now considering introducing a quality assurance system.

(b)(i) Explain one possible cause for the quality expectations of Kōwhai Naturals not being met.

(b)(ii) Explain the effect the introduction of a quality assurance system will likely have on the economic sustainability of Kōwhai Naturals.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement: Explain one possible cause (e.g. different understanding of recycled material standards between Vietnam and New Zealand; what is considered 'premium' packaging may differ between markets). For the quality assurance effect: It will have a positive effect on economic sustainability. Each production stage is monitored to ensure quality standards are met, meaning consistently high-quality packaging is produced, maintaining premium brand image, retaining loyal customers, and supporting continued export growth. Merit: Fully explain with further expansion. Excellence: Justify by integrating detailed evidence.

questions.text:
Kōwhai Naturals has been experiencing delays in receiving finished packaging shipped from Vietnam. There is discussion about whether a trade agreement between New Zealand and Vietnam could improve the situation.

(c)(i) Explain one possible cause for the delay in receiving orders by Kōwhai Naturals.

(c)(ii) Explain how improved trade relations between New Zealand and Vietnam could benefit Kōwhai Naturals.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement: Explain one possible cause for delays (e.g. customs processing time due to compliance checks on imported packaging materials, or limited direct shipping routes between Vietnam and New Zealand adding transit time). For trade relations: Improved trade relations could streamline customs processes, potentially reduce tariffs on packaging imports, and encourage more frequent shipping services between the two countries, reducing delivery times and costs. Merit: Fully explain with further expansion. Excellence: Justify by integrating detailed evidence.

questions.text:
Kōwhai Naturals is considering purchasing new formulation software. They are choosing between BlendMaster Pro ($650/month, 12% average rate of return, no customer support line) and NaturFormula ($550/month, 10% average rate of return, 24/7 customer support included). The initial purchase cost for BlendMaster Pro is $10,500 and NaturFormula is $8,200.

(d)(i) Explain one positive effect choosing BlendMaster Pro would have on Kōwhai Naturals.

(d)(ii) Explain one positive effect choosing NaturFormula would have on Kōwhai Naturals.

(d)(iii) Which of the two software options would you recommend for Kōwhai Naturals? Justify your recommendation, including any new information.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement: Explain one benefit of BlendMaster Pro (e.g. higher average rate of return of 12%, providing a 12% average increase in efficiency on the $10,500 investment). Explain one benefit of NaturFormula (e.g. lower monthly cost of $550 vs $650, providing $1,200 savings per year). Merit: Fully explain with further expansion about effects on business goals. Excellence: For the recommendation, justify using evidence. E.g. Kōwhai Naturals should invest in NaturFormula because the initial savings of $2,300 and ongoing savings of $1,200 per year are significant. NaturFormula also provides 24/7 support, essential for a growing export business operating across time zones. Note: A recommendation for BlendMaster Pro is acceptable if suitably justified.
